'''September 2001 Madrid tournament (30 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Madrid, Spain on 30 September 2001. [[Heraclio Sanchez]] won it. It is known from Heraclio Sanchez's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3006">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-01-madrid-ithor-ep-i-closed-30-sept-01d3006/ madrid-ithor-ep-i-closed-30-sept-01], DeckTech (Heraclio "Morgoth" Sanchez, 1 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-01-madrid-ithor-ep-i-closed-30-sept-01d3006/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Madrid, Spain
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Heraclio Sanchez]]
